name: Should I prime my walls before installing a kitchen backsplash?

mainEntity.name: Should I prime my walls before installing a kitchen backsplash?

acceptedAnswer.text: Priming walls is highly recommended, especially if you are tiling over a porous surface, newly repaired drywall, or existing paint. Primer creates a consistent, non-porous surface that improves adhesion for the tile adhesive and helps prevent moisture absorption. It also ensures the color of the wall doesn't show through thin or light-colored tiles. For Maine Results, Inc. projects, we typically use a high-quality primer formulated to enhance bonding strength for tile installations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, priming improves adhesion, prevents moisture absorption, and ensures consistent appearance, especially on porous or repaired walls.
